papers.title: Osseointegration of Plasma-Modified Titanium Dental Implants Enhanced by Maca Nano-Suspension in New Zealand Rabbits: An Animal Study
papers.abstract: Abstract Objectives To investigate the potential effect of combined cold atmospheric plasma and Maca extract nano-suspension as a dual implant surface treatment on osseointegration. Materials and methods Maca nano-suspension was formulated and characterized. Thirty titanium implants were placed in the tibiae of ten adult male New Zealand rabbits and were divided into three groups: untreated, cold atmospheric plasma-treated implants, and cold atmospheric plasma + Maca extract-treated implants. Implant stability was assessed using the AnyCheck ® device at the time of placement (primary stability), and then after four weeks (secondary stability). Histomorphometric analysis of the processed bone specimens was performed. Statistical significance level was set at P ≤ 0.05. Results No statistical significance difference was noted regarding the primary stability between the groups, whereas the secondary stability was significantly greater in the cold atmospheric plasma-treated group compared with the untreated control group ( P- value = 0.015). Histomorphometric analysis showed significantly greater percentages of mineralized bone area around implants in the cold atmospheric plasma + Maca group compared with other groups. Conclusion The combination of cold atmospheric plasma and Maca extract resulted in a greater area percentage of newly formed mineralized bone, suggesting a potential beneficial effect on peri-implant bone regeneration.

llm.relevance_to_user: 该文研究牙种植体表面改性对兔胫骨骨整合的影响，与股骨柄应力遮挡、微动或界面力学无关。
llm.why_not_core: This is an animal study of dental implant surface chemistry and osseointegration with no femoral stem geometry, no FEA, no stress shielding or micromotion quantification, and no contact mechanics.

summary_zh.motivation: 探索冷等离子体与玛卡纳米悬浮液联合处理对钛种植体骨整合的促进作用。
summary_zh.method: 在十只兔胫骨植入三十枚钛种植体，分三组比较稳定性与组织形态学。
summary_zh.result: 联合处理组矿化骨面积百分比显著高于其他组，等离子体组次级稳定性优于对照。
summary_zh.validation: 兔胫骨动物实验结合AnyCheck稳定性测量与组织形态学分析。

summary_en.motivation: The study aimed to determine whether a dual surface treatment combining cold atmospheric plasma and Maca extract could improve peri-implant bone healing.
summary_en.method: Thirty titanium implants were placed in rabbit tibiae across untreated, plasma-treated, and plasma-plus-Maca groups, with stability measured by resonance frequency analysis and histomorphometric evaluation.
summary_en.result: The combined treatment yielded a significantly larger mineralized bone area fraction, while plasma alone improved secondary stability relative to untreated controls.
summary_en.validation: In vivo rabbit implantation with device-based stability testing and histological histomorphometry.

papers.title: Hybrid Metaheuristic–AI Modeling for Accurate Prediction of CO₂ Solubility in Amine–Ionic Liquid Hybrid Solvents
papers.abstract: Reducing CO₂ emissions from fossil-fuel-based processes requires accurate and reliable predictive tools for designing advanced solvent systems for post-combustion carbon capture. In this study, an extensive experimental database of CO₂ solubility in hybrid amine–ionic liquid (IL) solvents was compiled and modeled using four hybrid metaheuristic–machine-learning frameworks: Histogram-Based Gradient Boosting combined with the Multi-Verse Optimization Algorithm (HistGBoost-MVOA), Tabular Neural Network combined with the Moth-Flame Optimization Algorithm (TabNet-MFOA), Support Vector Regression combined with the Improved Whale Optimization Algorithm (SVR-IWOA), and Extreme Learning Machine combined with the Jellyfish Optimization Algorithm (ELM-JFOA). The input variables included temperature, amine concentration, IL concentration, molecular weights of the amine and IL, and CO₂ partial pressure, while the CO₂ mole fraction in the liquid phase (xCO₂) was considered the target variable. To ensure robust model development, outlier detection was performed using the Isolation Forest algorithm, followed by Robust Scaling for data normalization. Model performance was evaluated using repeated 10-fold cross-validation and independent testing based on R², RMSE, MAE, MAPE, and PBIAS, together with Taylor diagrams, centered RMSE (cRMSE), SHAP-based interpretability analysis, and bootstrap uncertainty quantification. All developed models demonstrated excellent predictive capability (testing R² > 0.96), with SVR-IWOA consistently achieving the highest prediction accuracy and the narrowest uncertainty intervals. SHAP analysis identified the molecular weight of the ionic liquid and temperature as the most influential variables governing CO₂ solubility. The proposed modeling framework provides a robust and interpretable data-driven approach for accurately predicting CO₂ solubility and supports the design and optimization of hybrid amine–ionic liquid solvents for carbon capture applications.

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文用元启发式-机器学习混合模型预测胺-离子液体溶剂的CO₂溶解度，属于化学工程性质预测，与FEA代理建模、植入物生物力学设计无直接关联。
llm.why_not_core: This paper performs data-driven solubility regression for carbon capture solvents with no FEA, no surrogate modeling of PDE/solid mechanics, no implant or biomechanics context, and no constraint handling or design optimization relevant to implant design.

summary_zh.method: 构建四种元启发式优化与机器学习结合的混合回归框架并做SHAP解释。
summary_zh.result: 各模型测试R²均超过0.96，SVR-IWOA精度最高且不确定性区间最窄。
summary_zh.validation: 重复10折交叉验证、独立测试集与bootstrap不确定性量化。

summary_en.motivation: Accurate prediction of CO2 solubility is needed to design hybrid amine–ionic liquid solvents for post-combustion carbon capture.
summary_en.method: Four hybrid metaheuristic–machine-learning regressors were trained on a compiled experimental solubility database with outlier filtering, robust scaling, and SHAP interpretation.
summary_en.result: All models exceeded a testing R² of 0.96, with the SVR-IWOA framework attaining the highest accuracy and narrowest bootstrap uncertainty intervals.
summary_en.validation: Performance was assessed via repeated 10-fold cross-validation, an independent test set, Taylor diagrams, and bootstrap uncertainty quantification.
